success.title: Success
success.description: Indicates whether entity resolution completed successfully.

matchType.title: Match Type
matchType.description: EXACT_LINE_ITEM, ADVERTISER_MATCH, ORDER_MATCH, MULTIPLE_MATCHES, or NO_MATCH.

requiresDisambiguation.title: Requires Disambiguation
requiresDisambiguation.description: True when more than one advertiser or order matched. The agent must ask the user to choose before proceeding.

matchedLineItemId.title: Matched Line Item ID
matchedLineItemId.description: The Line Item ID matched, when the search text was an exact Line Item ID.

matchedAdvertiserName.title: Matched Advertiser Name
matchedAdvertiserName.description: The advertiser name matched, when exactly one advertiser matched.

matchedOrderName.title: Matched Order Name
matchedOrderName.description: The order name matched, when exactly one order matched.

candidateAdvertisers.title: Candidate Advertisers
candidateAdvertisers.description: Semicolon-separated list of advertiser names that matched, when disambiguation is required.

candidateOrders.title: Candidate Orders
candidateOrders.description: Semicolon-separated list of order names that matched, when disambiguation is required.

candidateLineItemCount.title: Candidate Line Item Count
candidateLineItemCount.description: Number of line items behind the matched advertiser or order.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the resolution result.
